title: Viral Mods
description: This is a mod I made for a YouTube video that is a recreation of 7 viral minecraft mods
body:
# ViralMods

A Minecraft Forge mod that recreates 7 viral Minecraft games in one package. All games can be stopped at any time by typing `stop` in chat.

---

**Block Guessing** — `/block_guessing_game <2-10>`

A singleplayer guessing game. A random set of blocks is displayed behind a wall — you're given the same blocks shuffled in your inventory and must place them in the correct order. Press the stone button to submit your guess and it tells you how many are in the right position. Keep guessing until you get them all right. Your final score is the number of guesses it took.

---

**Pillars of Fortune** — `/pillars_of_fortune <player1> ... <player8>`

Up to 8 players are teleported to the top of tall bedrock pillars high in the sky. Every 5 seconds each player receives a completely random item from the entire item registry. Last player standing wins — fall off your pillar and you're eliminated.

---

**Mob Powers** — `/mob-powers`

Toggle on/off for all players on the server. When active, killing specific mobs grants you their power:

| Mob | Power |
|---|---|
| Enderman | Right-click with empty hand to teleport 50 blocks in your look direction |
| Iron Golem | 80 max health and high attack damage, but very slow movement |
| Bat / Vex | Creative flight |
| Creeper | Crouch to trigger a massive explosion (10 second cooldown) |

Run the command again to turn it off and reset all players' stats.

---

**Death Swap** — `/deathswap <player1> <player2>`

A classic 2-player game. Every 5 minutes the two players swap positions. Countdown warnings appear in chat at 4, 3, 2, and 1 minute remaining, followed by a 10-second countdown. The goal is to be in a dangerous position when the swap happens so your opponent dies. First player to die loses.

---

**Mob Hide & Seek** — `/mob-hide-and-seek <player1> ... <player5>`

2 to 5 players. Once started, type a mob name in chat to disguise yourself — you turn invisible and a mob entity mirrors your exact position and rotation. Type `animals` to see the full list, or `self` to remove your disguise.

| Command | Mob | Special |
|---|---|---|
| `sheep` | Sheep | — |
| `cow` | Cow | — |
| `pig` | Pig | — |
| `bat` | Bat | Grants flight |
| `zombie` | Zombie | — |
| `creeper` | Creeper | — |
| `villager` | Villager | — |
| `witch` | Witch | — |

---

**One Block** — `/one-block <block>`

A singleplayer challenge. Pick any block — you must stay only on that block type at all times. Every tick the game checks the blocks at your feet, head, and below you. Touch any other non-air block and you instantly die and the game ends.

---

**Skyblock** — `/skyblock-random-items`

Singleplayer skyblock challenge. You're teleported to a small bedrock platform at Y=299 high in the sky. Every 15 seconds you receive a completely random item from the entire item registry. A boss bar counts down to the next item. Fall below Y=260 and you're instantly killed and the game ends.

---

Type `stop` in chat at any time to end any running game.
